Container.Name: subarr
Container.Overview:
The coordination layer for the *arr subtitle stack. Subarr stands beside Bazarr, never instead of it: Bazarr finds and downloads, subgen transcribes, and subarr coordinates. It decides what subtitles are actually missing across Sonarr/Radarr/Bazarr per language, keeps a provenance ledger, schedules Whisper walks with backpressure, and verifies the spoken audio language by ear (it tells a mislabeled track from a bilingual one from "genuinely unsure", with one-click fixes that flow back into coverage). A built-in Tuning Lab finds the Whisper settings that win on your hardware.
REQUIRES a subgen container for transcription (ghcr.io/coaxk/subarr-subgen recommended; vanilla mccloudS/subgen works in compat mode). Benefits from Bazarr plus Sonarr/Radarr, and optionally Tautulli, Plex, and Ollama. The onboarding wizard auto-detects these on your Docker network on first run at the WebUI; manual entry is available at every step. Subarr itself is CPU-only, no GPU required (that is subgen's job).
First run: open the WebUI and complete the onboarding wizard. Anonymous telemetry is on by default; opt out in one click in the wizard or in Settings.
Container.Requires: Requires a running subgen container (ghcr.io/coaxk/subarr-subgen recommended). Bazarr plus Sonarr/Radarr strongly recommended. Optional: Tautulli, Plex, Ollama, and a tecnativa docker-socket-proxy for auto-discovery.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Web interface / API port. If you change this, also set the SUBARR_PORT variable below to match.

Config.Name: Config (appdata)
Config.Description: Stores the SQLite database (subarr.db) and persisted settings. The SUBARR_DB_PATH variable below points the DB into this folder.

Config.Name: Media Library
Config.Description: Your media root. MUST be the same path Bazarr and subgen see. Switch Mode to read-only and set SUBARR_SIDECAR_RENAME=0 if you do not want subarr writing sidecars.

Config.Name: Docker Socket (optional, auto-discovery)
Config.Description: OPTIONAL. Read-only Docker access lets the onboarding wizard auto-detect your arr stack. Prefer pointing SUBARR_DOCKER_PROXY_URL at a tecnativa docker-socket-proxy instead of mounting the raw socket. Leave blank if you enter integration URLs manually.

Config.Name: SUBARR_PORT
Config.Description: Port the app listens on inside the container. Keep equal to the WebUI host port mapping above.

Config.Name: SUBARR_DB_PATH
Config.Description: SQLite path. Must live inside the Config (appdata) volume above.

Config.Name: SUBARR_MEDIA_ROOT
Config.Description: Container path of the media root (matches the Media Library path target above).

Config.Name: SUBGEN_URL
Config.Description: Base URL of your subgen container's API. Default assumes a container named 'subgen' on the same Docker network.

Config.Name: SUBGEN_CONTAINER
Config.Description: Name of the subgen container (used for log/restart actions from the UI).

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID (Unraid 'nobody' = 99).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID (Unraid 'users' = 100).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File-creation umask.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone, e.g. Australia/Sydney.

Config.Name: BAZARR_URL
Config.Description: Optional. e.g. http://bazarr:6767

Config.Name: BAZARR_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional. Bazarr API key.

Config.Name: SONARR_URL
Config.Description: Optional. e.g. http://sonarr:8989

Config.Name: SONARR_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional. Sonarr API key.

Config.Name: RADARR_URL
Config.Description: Optional. e.g. http://radarr:7878

Config.Name: RADARR_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional. Radarr API key.

Config.Name: TAUTULLI_URL
Config.Description: Optional. e.g. http://tautulli:8181 - adds playback-priority signal.

Config.Name: TAUTULLI_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional. Tautulli API key.

Config.Name: PLEX_URL
Config.Description: Optional. e.g. http://192.168.1.10:32400 - enables instant library refresh on sub write.

Config.Name: PLEX_TOKEN
Config.Description: Optional. Plex X-Plex-Token.

Config.Name: OLLAMA_URL
Config.Description: Optional. e.g. http://ollama:11434 - enables language enrichment + vision pre-filter.

Config.Name: SUBARR_DOCKER_PROXY_URL
Config.Description: Optional. URL of a tecnativa docker-socket-proxy for read-only auto-discovery (preferred over mounting the raw socket).

Config.Name: SUBARR_USER
Config.Description: Optional. HTTP Basic auth user (single-admin fallback; prefer a reverse proxy).

Config.Name: SUBARR_PASS
Config.Description: Optional. HTTP Basic auth password.
